edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the _from address when transfer() delegates to transferFrom()
msg.sender is compared against allowance[_from][msg.sender] and decremented in transferFrom()
msg.sender becomes the owner key of the allowance mapping written in approve()
delegate() gates the arbitrary delegatecall behind require(msg.sender == owner)
init() gates configuration of sale thresholds behind require(msg.sender == owner)
batchSend() gates mass transfers behind require(msg.sender == owner)
setTradeAddress() gates the whitelist update behind require(msg.sender == owner)
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged role
transfer() delegates all work to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
transferFrom() calls ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating balances
ensure() falls through to require(condition(_from, _value)) when no whitelist bypass applies
ensure() computes the pair address via pairFor() for the whitelist comparison
delegate() performs a low-level delegatecall that hands execution control to external code in this contract's storage context
The _a parameter selects the delegatecall target executed by unsafe delegatecall
The _b calldata parameter flows into the delegatecall payload
transferFrom() decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath
transferFrom() decrements balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath
The _value parameter directly reduces the caller allowance
The _value parameter directly reduces the sender balance
The _from parameter is the key used for allowance and balance lookups in transferFrom()
The _to parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom()
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath
batchSend() subtracts the unchecked total from balanceOf[msg.sender]
The _tos array length and elements drive the batchSend loop
The _value amount feeds the unchecked multiplication and each loop credit
The local total variable carries the unchecked product into the balance subtraction
The loop-local recipient receives balanceOf credits in batchSend()
The saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum by init()
The token parameter scales into _minSale by init()
The maxToken parameter scales into _maxSale by init()
init() writes the _saleNum state variable
init() writes the _minSale state variable
init() writes the _maxSale state variable
condition() reads _saleNum to bound per-address sales
condition() reads _minSale to bound the minimum transfer value
condition() reads _maxSale to bound the maximum transfer value
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against _saleNum
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] after a successful transfer
ensure() compares _from/_to against the owner state variable
ensure() consults canSale[_from] for the whitelist bypass
ensure() compares _from against the tradeAddress whitelist member
ensure() compares _from against the constant UNI router address
The local _UNI pair address participates in the ensure() whitelist comparison
transferFrom() reads and writes balanceOf for sender and recipient
transferFrom() reads and writes allowance[_from][msg.sender]
batchSend() reads and writes balanceOf for msg.sender and each recipient
approve() writes an arbitrary allowance[msg.sender][_spender] value
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress whitelist member
constructor sets owner = msg.sender
constructor mints the whole supply to msg.sender in balanceOf
constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router
constructor sets totalSupply from _supply scaled by decimals
decimals scales the min/max sale thresholds in init()
pairFor() hashes factory/token addresses and its CREATE2-style result feeds whitelist trust used before the delegatecall path

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _from is only meaningful as the source key used by transferFrom() for allowance and balance accounting
Parameter _to is only meaningful as the credited recipient inside transferFrom()
Parameter _value is the amount consumed by the unchecked allowance decrement
Parameter a is the target address supplied directly to the unsafe delegatecall
Parameter b is the calldata payload of the owner-restricted delegate() entry point
Parameter _tos only bounds and supplies the loop in batchSend()
Parameter _value is the multiplicand of the unchecked batch total computation
Parameter saleNum is simply stored into _saleNum by init()
Parameter token is simply scaled and stored into _minSale by init()
Parameter maxToken is simply scaled and stored into _maxSale by init()
Local _UNI exists only to hold the pairFor() result used in the ensure() whitelist comparison
Local total exists only to carry the unchecked product into the balance subtraction
Loop-local loop_to exists only to credit balances inside batchSend()
